title: Agent Stack run event
description: One line of .agent-stack/runs/<run-id>/events.jsonl. Append-only; never edited or reordered. The resolver appends an event for every transition, evidence item, verification result, and external side effect. Watch telemetry types (agent-start, agent-end, handoff, report, jev-request, jev-response, usage) are a read-only teaching overlay consumed by `astack watch`; only the resolver may use transition/record-* writers. See docs/watch.md for detail payload shapes (detail is a string; structured payloads are JSON-encoded).
